entities.name: Vojtěch Hruban
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vojtěch Hruban is a Czech basketball player for ERA Basketball Nymburk of the Czech Republic National Basketball League (NBL). He also represents the Czech Republic national team. With more than 1.000 points is ranked second in the all-time scoring list of the Basketball Champions League.
